title: Privilege change after suspicious authentication
why_it_fired: Privilege change to 'GlobalAdmin' for 'a.patel' occurred within 15 minutes of a successful login following repeated failures.
rule_threshold: privilege change within 15 minutes after suspicious authentication
recommended_actions: Confirm the role change against an approved change ticket and authorized administrator. | Inspect identity-provider audit logs and actions taken with the new privilege. | If unauthorized, remove the grant, revoke sessions, preserve evidence, and escalate to the incident lead.

title: Password spraying pattern
why_it_fired: Source 198.51.100.23 failed authentication for 9 distinct users in 10 minutes; threshold is 8.
rule_threshold: 8 distinct users / 10 minutes / same source IP
recommended_actions: Check whether the source is a known corporate proxy, VPN, or identity provider. | Review targeted accounts for subsequent successful logins. | Apply approved rate limiting and MFA protections; avoid blocking shared infrastructure without validation.

title: Successful login after repeated failures
why_it_fired: A successful login for 'a.patel' from 203.0.113.77 followed 5 failures within 10 minutes.
rule_threshold: success within 10 minutes after 5+ failures / same user + source IP
recommended_actions: Validate the successful login with the account owner and expected source/location. | Review MFA result, device posture, session activity, and the next 15 minutes of events. | If compromise is suspected, revoke sessions and rotate credentials using the incident-response process.

title: Repeated authentication failures
why_it_fired: Observed 5 failed authentications for user 'a.patel' from 203.0.113.77 within 5 minutes; threshold is 5.
rule_threshold: 5 failures / 5 minutes / same user + source IP
recommended_actions: Verify whether the source and target user are expected. | Check adjacent authentication events and endpoint telemetry. | If unauthorized, block or rate-limit the source through approved controls and reset affected credentials.
